title: Surreal Hallway Dream
description: A dimly lit, melancholic room shows a person’s arm resting on a wooden desk with a mug, vintage radio, and scattered keys. A large surreal painting dominates the wall, depicting an endless dripping hallway with melting walls, a glowing red door at the far end, and a colorful hot air balloon floating near the ceiling under a stormy purple sky. Rain streaks down from the skylight above.
prompt: A moody interior scene of a dark blue-grey room with rain falling through a skylight. On the left, a wooden desk holds a white mug, vintage radio, and keys, with a person's arm resting on it. A massive surreal painting hangs on the wall showing an endless dripping hallway with melting fabric-like walls, multiple doors, a glowing red door at the end, and a colorful striped hot air balloon floating near the ceiling with paint dripping from it, under a dark purple stormy sky.
